internal_discovery.plain_explanation: All three occurrences are the plural hada'iq: delightful gardens, gardens and grapes, and dense gardens. The corpus establishes the referential garden class but offers no verbs or contrasts from which to extract a deeper abstract mechanism.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Modifiers supply delight, density, or produce; the root contributes the garden-space referent. No unobserved enclosure feature is imported.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: Because every token is the same plural noun, universal presence may reflect lexical repetition rather than a tested derivational core.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The root specifically means enclosed garden; enclosure is not expressed in the three Quranic contexts and is therefore not adopted.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Distinctiveness is limited to the observed cultivated-garden referent; separation from other garden terms is not securely established by this packet alone.
internal_discovery.rationale: Coverage is universal, but semantic abstraction and neighbor contrast are evidence-limited.
